assessment.scope: Two-round zero-context independent full-chapter B14 reader review (8a6c4ffd) across all 42 canonical paragraphs (14 / 13 / 15 across three sections), section joins, caveats, and cross-chapter bridges, with complete self-sufficient derivations for all five comprehension and transfer problems.
assessment.findings: Synchronized opening (P01) and closing (P41) enumeration seams across all four B14 structures, introduced Individualist/Hierarchist/Egalitarian perspective names and RIVM 2016-0104 vs 2017 paper disambiguation at first appearance in P14, explained preliminary N2O status, removed meta-outline scaffolding and explicitly defined k (1/lifetime) and Ft in P28, paired English synonym flow names (Methyl bromide / Bromomethane) and UUID glosses in P29, fixed forward-looking Chapter 16 reference and non-duplicative P30->P31 bridge, and split multi-clause sentences.
answers: Contrasts B14 four structures: land embeds passive recovery at midpoint (E=kM preserves order); minerals split stock ADP vs grade-tonnage SOP and uniform Cu cost vs metal-specific SCP (reversing Cu/Mn); fossil fuels sum heating values (with/without uranium) at midpoint but use fuel-specific cost curves + proxies with no constant factor at endpoint; ozone & radiation stop at physical/collective-dose midpoints and add UV-disease or DDREF/cancer-site/hereditary assumptions for DALY (no ecosystem endpoints).

For 1.5 kg N2O vs 0.25 kg HCFC-22: EF 3.1 gives 0 < 0.0085 (Y>X) and ReCiPe I gives 0.0105 < 0.02125 (Y>X), reversing in ReCiPe H (0.0165 > 0.01125, X>Y) and E (0.0255 > 0.0100, X>Y); no positive scalar maps 0 to >0 or reverses lifetime-dependent horizon ratios.

For 2 kBq C-14 (M), 5 kBq Cs-137 (N), and 10 kBq U-238 + 10 kBq Th-230 (T) to air: EF 3.1 ranks T (25.26) > M (20.0) > N (3.18) and ReCiPe E ranks T (32.21) > M (25.8) > N (8.20), whereas ReCiPe H (100 yr) truncates C-14 to 2.30 and leaves U-238/Th-230 blank (0), ranking N (8.20) > M (2.30) > T (0).

Within one perspective a positive constant preserves midpoint order, but across perspectives horizons, U/Th coverage, cataracts/cancer sites, and DDREF (10/6/2) shift together; global defaults (10-deg latitude indigenous skin maps; French nuclear releases with 10B constant population for 100,000 yr) cannot replace site-specific dose compliance.

RIVM (-t-3)*k Table 3.2 spreadsheet behavior and JRC109369 vs EF 3.1 XML compartment/property/synonym discrepancies prove prose, equations, tables, and XMLs require independent UUID/CAS/row verification, bridging P30 into land, fossil, mineral, and USES-LCA 2.0 / USEtox model-data-factor separation.
